component.name: Lodestone
component.summary: One library for all your games on Linux

description.p: Lodestone brings the games you own on every store into one library, and runs Windows games and store apps through Proton without needing Steam.

ul.li: Steam, Epic Games, GOG, Amazon, Battle.net, EA, Ubisoft, Lutris, Heroic and Minecraft in one place, installed or not
Install, update and uninstall Epic and GOG games directly, and Steam games in the background
Battle.net, EA app and Ubisoft Connect set up on Proton, or used from Lutris or Steam where you already have them
Downloads tab with speed, sizes, time left and history
Play time from Steam, Epic, Lutris and Heroic, plus everything you play through Lodestone
Game details, news, ProtonDB ratings and artwork, with an editor for titles, covers and install locations
MangoHud performance overlay, set up and configured from the app
Steam friends, and who among them owns a game
Mods through Kiln, a separate mod manager: Lodestone shows which games it can mod and plays them with their mods checked
Minecraft hub for mods, resource packs and shaders (in active development: works with ATLauncher today, Prism Launcher support is early)

description.p: Lodestone is not affiliated with Valve, Epic Games, GOG, Amazon, Blizzard, Electronic Arts, Ubisoft or Mojang.
